root_cause.text: In team_setup_by_port(), the team device inherits the lower device's header_ops pointer directly for non-Ethernet ports, causing header operation callbacks to be invoked with the team net_device instead of the actual port device, leading to type confusion when those callbacks access netdev_priv().
root_cause.evidence: From the commit message: "For non-Ethernet ports, team_setup_by_port() copies port_dev->header_ops directly. When the team device later calls dev_hard_header() or dev_parse_header(), these callbacks can run with the team net_device instead of the real lower device, so netdev_priv(dev) is interpreted as the wrong private type and can crash." The patch fixes this by introducing wrapper functions that select a port under RCU and call the lower device callbacks with port->dev.
